- All four console projections match the retained typed projections **as exact serialized text**, including property names, nulls and values. Actor counts remain **2/1/1/1**, with unchanged typed-read save bytes.

I ran read-only hash, JSON, source and receipt reconciliation. **I did not execute PowerShell/C#, gameplay, engine restores, static validation, or observe workers.**

Preserve original regression `72f6bdda`; no restart is required for this host-only change.
